correctness.rationale: For q≥3, the direct-product fiber-local independence and domination predicates force 0, singleton(c), or full F fibers. Singleton selections form monochromatic runs of length≥2; legal gaps and color changes yield the two-state rational matrix R_q(t,z) with F node A=t z^q and C node B=t²z²/(1-tz). The specified boundary vectors count each admissible fiber word exactly once. Length-composition counts give the three residue-class optimum multiplicities and the unique extra 0F0 at (ell,q)=(3,3). Positive irreducible analytic transfer has a unique dominant simple pole (F→F moves of lengths 2,3 remove periodic ambiguity); non-cohomology of cardinality per length gives positive asymptotic variance, hence a quasi-power Gaussian limit at fixed q. Independent original-graph bitmask enumeration checked seven (ell,q) choices and minimum sizes/multiplicities; the infinite and CLT proof is analytic, not numerical.
